closed_prior_design_note: The earlier design review requested that invalid-pin controls prove rejection before tool setup. The new Rust black-box control asserts an empty fixture tool trace and null version/list fields; this closes that note.

implementation_assessment.assertion_preservation: Existing Rust test declarations are preserved; only the two assertions hardcoded to current/accepted q24 change to expected accepted q34/current q38. New controls cover obsolete tuple, wrong owner/token/work ID/revision, extra/duplicate fields, pin Boolean revision, and Boolean canonical revisions.
implementation_assessment.canonical_claim_checks: Compares pin owner/token/accepted revision to the unique canonical VIS-04 row; retains branch, claimed/in_progress, base ancestry, and exact allowed-path checks. Pin values are a consistency expectation and are not treated as authentication.
implementation_assessment.fail_closed_order: Claim pin/canonical record validation runs before environment capture, tool version, Nextest list, or test. New black-box controls check zero executions and an empty tool trace for bad pins and Boolean registry revisions.
implementation_assessment.pin_parser: Requires exactly schema/work_id/expected_owner/expected_claim_token/expected_accepted_queue_revision; rejects duplicate keys, missing/unknown fields, non-string/empty string fields, unsupported schema/work ID, non-integer or non-positive accepted revision.
implementation_assessment.required_affected_gate: After Root grants execution, run exactly all 29 names from test-names.json in target termrock-visibility-tests::deferred; no old 27-test receipt or product result can qualify this patch.
implementation_assessment.revision_semantics: Uses strict integer checks (type(value) is int, so Boolean is rejected); requires current q38 >= accepted q34 and records the values separately. Receipt also records SHA-256 of raw caller pin bytes.
